exact_lines71_80.text: - **Rule 10 binds the maintainer's own API proofs:** read other files' TCSlib definitions only
through their published equations. Core and Mathlib definitions may reduce by `rfl`, `decide`
or `show`, but are never passed to `simp`, `rw` or `unfold`.
- **Check:** a sealed copy (`attribute [local irreducible]` on every other-file TCSlib
definition reached; `attribute [-simp]` on the `@[simp]` ones that exist in the closure),
each new section moved into its own `section` in a scratch copy.
- **Controls:** an `rfl` delta goal and an equation goal per sealed definition. They pass
- Also inspect every `rw`/`simp`/`unfold` argument, since `simp [Def]` unfolds even a sealed

mandatory_guard_scope: Every reached other-file TCSlib ordinary definition (projection/abbreviation exclusions explicit), not all Core/Mathlib ordinary heads.
Core_Mathlib_scope: Definitions may reduce by rfl/decide/show under standing workflow, but explicit simp/rw/unfold arguments are prohibited; the full argument review additionally records delta/change sites.
actual_collector_scope: ImportedInventory.lean.txt lines33-34 tests TCSlib owner prefix excluding current Ladner owner, then skips other owners. Nine guard names/eight homes are therefore TCSlib-bounded and satisfy that policy scope.
supplement_not_required: No broader non-TCS collector, new seal or new Lean execution is required solely by this wording clarification.
